title: Public Grant Ledger
creator: feitianbf
summary: BSD-3-Clause Rust reconciliation tool with a hosted read-only review page. It compares payment outcomes, assets, integer amounts and payees, keeping receipt provenance in CSV output. Its samples distinguish local-engine grant payments from archived Ootle mainnet auction proceeds and escrow funding; those archives do not establish a deployed grant contract. The README explicitly excludes wallet signing and on-chain deployment. November 17, 2026: server-side extraction returned the hosted review interface and its offline/read-only boundary. The recording is a walkthrough of the Chinese-language README, not an application run or independent verification of the archived receipts.
cardSummary: Compare approved payments with archived transaction receipts, flag discrepancies and duplicate entries, and export evidence-linked reconciliation rows.

technologies.label: Rust CLI · Read-only web interface · BSD-3-Clause
